data.description:
## Context / Problem
The storm suite exercises writer-writer contention; ed2b (pagination under concurrent writes) showed READ paths under a writer storm are an uncovered generic property — no bespoke per-change tests should exist for this (bug-trend review change 20, one-time machinery addition).

## Approach
One property-style test in the existing storm module: while a writer storm runs (existing fixture), a reader repeatedly executes the paged/list/show read surfaces and asserts invariants (no crash, no duplicate/missing ids within a single paged traversal, monotonic pagination progress). Parameterize over the public read surfaces rather than writing one test per op.

## Scope
- tests/integration/test_store_concurrency.py (or sibling module reusing its fixtures)

## Testing
The test IS the deliverable; verify it fails on a seeded regression (e.g., temporarily reintroduce the ed2b pagination fault locally) before trusting green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Generic read-under-storm property runs over the paged read surfaces using the existing storm fixtures.
- [ ] Demonstrated RED on a seeded ed2b-class fault; green on main.
- [ ] No bespoke per-operation copies; parameterization covers surfaces.
data.title: Concurrency suite: generic reads-under-writer-storm property
